main_text.l: HInc sibi Rhetorice totis facunda Cratonem

l.i: Inde sibi Velut e gremio diuina Mathesis,
Cæsaribus contra esse suum Medicina probabat,
Et dubium certamen erat: quod sic Deus ipse
Vos, ait, Vt Viuus coluit Crato, nobile nomen
Ipse mihi Vero quum sese Vosque sacrarit,
Dixit, & ille Volans, terra cunctisque relicti-

page.notes: The initial H is a large woodcut-style letter. The Greek-looking long-s and "Ꝟ" forms in the italic verse are read as V/U. The line "CLARIS" at the foot is cut off at the page edge and is a fragment. Some words in the italic verse are uncertain and should be checked against the scan.
